_root_video_tab.name: Video
_root_video_adapterIndex.name: GPU index
_root_video_displayRefreshRate.name: Refresh rate
_root_video_displayRefreshRate.descripti: Refresh rate to set for both SteamVR and the headset. Higher values require faster PC. 72 Hz is the maximum for Quest 1.
_root_video_preferredFps.name: Custom refresh rate
_root_video_resolutionDropdown.name: Video resolution
_root_video_resolutionDropdown.descripti:
100% results in the native resolution of the Oculus Quest. 
Setting the resolution can bring some improvement in visual quality, but is not recommended. 
A resolution lower than 100% can reduce latency and increase network performance
_root_video_renderResolution_scale.name: Scale
_root_video_secondsFromVsyncToPhotons.de: The time elapsed from the virtual VSync until the image is visible on the viewer screen
_root_video_foveatedRendering.name: Foveated encoding
_root_video_foveatedRendering_enabled.de: Rendering technique that reduces the resolution of the image at the periphery of the vision to reduce the computational load on the GPU. Results in a much lower video resolution that needs to be transmitted over the network.
_root_video_foveatedRendering_content_ce: Higher value moves the uncompressed center towards the middle of your vision
Higher value moves the uncompressed center towards the bottom of your vision
_root_video_foveatedRendering_content_ed: Compression strength of the left and right edges
Compression strength of the top and bottom edges
_root_video_colorCorrection.name: Color correction
_root_video_colorCorrection_enabled.desc: Color correction are applied in the following order: Sharpening, Gamma, Brightness, Contrast, and Saturation.
_root_video_colorCorrection_content_brig: Brightness: -1 means completely black and 1 means completely white.
_root_video_colorCorrection_content_satu: Saturation: -1 means the image is black and white.
_root_video_colorCorrection_content_gamm: Gamut: Use a value of 2.2 to correct the color from sRGB to RGB. This controls the brightness but keeps blacks to black and whites to white
_root_video_colorCorrection_content_shar: Sharpness: emphasizes the edges of the image.
_root_video_codec-choice-.name: Video codec
_root_video_codec-choice-.description: HEVC is preferred to achieve better visual quality on lower bitrates. AMD video cards work best with HEVC.
_root_video_codec_H264-choice-.name: h264
_root_video_codec_HEVC-choice-.name: HEVC (h265)
_root_video_swThreadCount.name: Number of threads (software encoding)
_root_video_swThreadCount.description: Sets the amount of threads to use when using software encoding. Setting to 0 will use the max amount available.
_root_video_encodeBitrateMbs.name: Video Bitrate
_root_video_encodeBitrateMbs.description:
Bitrate of video streaming. 25Mbps is recommended for the Oculus Go. 
Higher bitrates result in better image but also higher latency and network traffic
_root_video_adaptiveBitrate.name: Adaptive bitrate
_root_video_adaptiveBitrate_enabled.desc: Use frame time or user selected target to adjust bitrate
_root_video_adaptiveBitrate_content_bitr: Adaptive bitrate will not use a bitrate higher than this limit
_root_video_adaptiveBitrate_content_late: This value will be used as the target network latency if not using frame time
Use FPS as the target network latency
Adaptive bitrate will not use a target network latency higher than this limit if using frame time
The target latency is offset by this amount
Adaptive bitrate will adjust bitrate when the network latency reaches the latency threshold
_root_video_adaptiveBitrate_content_bitr: How much to increase bitrate when the network latency reaches the latency threshold
How much to decrease bitrate when the network latency reaches the latency threshold
Limit increasing bitrate if sent rate is below threshold percentage of bitrate. Prevents stutters caused when switching from simple scenes to complex scenes
_root_audio_tab.name: Audio
_root_audio_linuxBackend-choice-.name: Linux backend
_root_audio_linuxBackend-choice-.descrip: To use the JACK backend you may need to configure it in Catia or equivalent software
_root_audio_gameAudio.name: Stream game audio
_root_audio_gameAudio_enabled.descriptio: Audio device used to capture game audio. This is used to configure SteamVR audio output.
_root_audio_gameAudio_content_muteWhenSt: Mutes the audio output (speakers/headphones) when streaming to the headset. Only the physical output is muted (to avoid double audio), stream to the headset and other capturing software will not be affected.
_root_audio_gameAudio_content_config_ave: Increasing this value may reduce audio stuttering.
_root_audio_microphone.name: Stream headset microphone
_root_audio_microphone_enabled.descripti:
Streams the headset microphone to SteamVR. 
To make the microphone work you need to install VB-CABLE Virtual Audio Device or another equivalent software.
The virtual microphone input is the recording device, the virtual microphone output is the audio rendering device, which is used to configure SteamVR microphone.
_root_audio_microphone_content_inputDevi: Output device used to render the microphone audio.
_root_audio_microphone_content_outputDev: Input device used as microphone. This is used to configure SteamVR microphone.
_root_audio_microphone_content_config_av: Increasing this value may reduce audio stuttering.
_root_headset_tab.name: Headset
_root_headset_trackingFrameOffset.name: Tracking frame offset
_root_headset_trackingFrameOffset.descri: Offset for the pose prediction algorithm
_root_headset_positionOffset.name: Headset position offset
_root_headset_positionOffset.description: Headset position offset used by the position prediction algorithm.
_root_headset_positionOffset_0.name: X
_root_headset_positionOffset_1.name: Y
_root_headset_positionOffset_2.name: Z
_root_headset_force3dof.name: Force 3Dof
_root_headset_force3dof.description: Forces the 3 degrees of freedom mode (like Oculus Go)
_root_headset_controllers.name: Controllers
_root_headset_controllers_enabled.descri: Allow the use of the controllers
_root_headset_controllers_content_tracki:
Recommended to use adaptive Oculus or SteamVR prediction. If you want to use fixed tracking speeds: Medium or fast for fast paced games like Beatsaber, normal for slower games like Skyrim. 
Oculus prediction means controller position is predicted on the headset instead of on the PC through SteamVR.
_root_headset_controllers_content_poseTi: Offset for the pose prediction algorithm
_root_headset_controllers_content_client: Use adaptive prediction from the headset
_root_headset_controllers_content_server:
Use adaptive prediction from the server. 
Allows using prediction cutoffs to reduce jittering with slow or precise movements
_root_headset_controllers_content_positi:
Position offset in meters for the left controller. 
For the right controller, x value is mirrored
_root_headset_controllers_content_rotati:
Rotation offset in degrees for the left controller. 
For the right controller, rotations along the Y and Z axes are mirrored
_root_connection_tab.name: Connection
_root_connection_clientDiscovery.name: Client discovery
_root_connection_webServerPort.name: Web server port
Network protocol used to stream data between client and server. UDP works best at low bitrates (<30), Throttled UDP works best at medium bitrates (~100), TCP works at any bitrate.
_root_connection_streamPort.name: Server streaming port
_root_connection_streamPort.description: Port used by the server to receive packets.
_root_connection_aggressiveKeyframeResen:
Decrease minimum interval between keyframes from 100 ms to 5 ms. 
Used only when packet loss is detected. 
Improves experience on networks with packet loss.
_root_connection_onConnectScript.name: On connect script
_root_connection_onConnectScript.descrip:
This script/executable will be run asynchronously when headset connects.
Environment variable ACTION will be set to "connect" (without quotes).
_root_connection_onDisconnectScript.name: On disconnect script
_root_connection_onDisconnectScript.desc:
This script/executable will be run asynchronously when headset disconnects and on SteamVR shutdown.
Environment variable ACTION will be set to "disconnect" (without quotes).
_root_extra_tab.name: Extra
_root_extra_clientDarkMode.name: Client dark mode
_root_extra_clientDarkMode.description: Applied after connection and sleep-wake cycle
_root_extra_restartConfirmDialog.name: Confirm SteamVR restart
_root_extra_logToDisk.name: Log to disk (session_log.txt)
_root_extra_notificationLevel-choice-.de:
At which level notification will be generated. From less details to all details: 
- Error 
- Warning 
- Informations 
- Debug
_root_extra_patches_linuxAsyncReprojecti: This is the cause of jitter on Linux. It should always be disabled on Nvidia GPUs. AMD users should keep it on.
audioDeviceError: No audio devices found. Cannot stream audio or microphone
